module {
  func.func @main(
    %weight: tensor<6x3x3x5x7xf32>,   // (out_channels, in_channels, kD, kH, kW)
    %input: tensor<8x3x16x7x7xf32>    // (batch, in_channels, D, H, W)
  ) -> tensor<8x6x14x3x1xf32> {
    // Transpose input from [N, C, D, H, W] -> [N, D, H, W, C]
    %input_t = stablehlo.transpose %input, dense<[0, 2, 3, 4, 1]> : tensor<8x3x16x7x7xf32> to tensor<8x16x7x7x3xf32>

    // Transpose weight from [O, I, kD, kH, kW] -> [O, kD, kH, kW, I]
    %weight_t = stablehlo.transpose %weight, dense<[0, 2, 3, 4, 1]> : tensor<6x3x3x5x7xf32> to tensor<6x3x5x7x3xf32>

    // Convolution: input [8,16,7,7,3], kernel [6,3,5,7,3], output [8,14,3,1,6]
    %conv = stablehlo.convolution
      %input_t, %weight_t,
      window_strides = dense<[1, 1, 1]>,
      padding = dense<[[0, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0]]>,
      lhs_dilation = dense<[1, 1, 1]>,
      rhs_dilation = dense<[1, 1, 1]>,
      feature_group_count = 1,
      batch_group_count = 1,
      dimension_numbers = #stablehlo.conv_dimension_numbers<
        input_batch_dimension = 0,
        input_feature_dimension = 4,
        input_spatial_dimensions = [1, 2, 3],
        kernel_output_feature_dimension = 0,
        kernel_input_feature_dimension = 4,
        kernel_spatial_dimensions = [1, 2, 3],
        output_batch_dimension = 0,
        output_feature_dimension = 4,
        output_spatial_dimensions = [1, 2, 3]
      >,
      precision_config = []
    : (tensor<8x16x7x7x3xf32>, tensor<6x3x5x7x3xf32>) -> tensor<8x14x3x1x6xf32>

    // Transpose output [8,14,3,1,6] -> [8,6,14,3,1]
    %out = stablehlo.transpose %conv, dense<[0, 4, 1, 2, 3]> : tensor<8x14x3x1x6xf32> to tensor<8x6x14x3x1xf32>

    return %out : tensor<8x6x14x3x1xf32>
  }
}

  func.func @main(
    %arg0: tensor<6x6x3x3xf32>, // weight: (C_in, C_out, KH, KW)
    %arg1: tensor<8x6x7x7xf32>  // input:  (N, C_in, H, W)
  ) -> tensor<8x6x9x9xf32> {
    // Transpose weight from (C_in, C_out, KH, KW) to (C_out, C_in, KH, KW)
    %0 = stablehlo.transpose(%arg0, dense<[1, 0, 2, 3]> : tensor<4xi64>) : (tensor<6x6x3x3xf32>, tensor<4xi64>) -> tensor<6x6x3x3xf32>

    %1 = stablehlo.reverse(%0, dense<[2, 3]> : tensor<2xi64>) : (tensor<6x6x3x3xf32>, tensor<2xi64>) -> tensor<6x6x3x3xf32>
    // Transposed convolution as regular convolution with padding
    %2 = stablehlo.convolution(
      %arg1, %1,
      window_strides = dense<[1, 1]> : tensor<2xi64>,
      padding = dense<[[2, 2], [2, 2]]> : tensor<2x2xi64>,
      lhs_dilation = dense<[1, 1]> : tensor<2xi64>,
      rhs_dilation = dense<[1, 1]> : tensor<2xi64>,

        kernel_output_feature_dimension = 0,
        kernel_input_feature_dimension = 1,
        kernel_spatial_dimensions = [2, 3],
        output_batch_dimension = 0,
        output_feature_dimension = 1,
        output_spatial_dimensions = [2, 3]
      >,
      precision_config = []
    ) : (tensor<8x6x7x7xf32>, tensor<6x6x3x3xf32>) -> tensor<8x6x9x9xf32>
    return %2 : tensor<8x6x9x9xf32>
  }
}

module {
  func.func @main(%arg0: tensor<6x16x3x3xf32>, %arg1: tensor<16x16x7x7xf32>) -> tensor<16x6x5x5xf32> {
    // Transpose input from NCHW [16,16,7,7] to NHWC [16,7,7,16]
    %cst0 = stablehlo.constant dense<[0, 2, 3, 1]> : tensor<4xi64>
    %0 = stablehlo.transpose(%arg1, %cst0) : (tensor<16x16x7x7xf32>, tensor<4xi64>) -> tensor<16x7x7x16xf32>
    // Transpose kernel from OIHW [6,16,3,3] to HWIO [3,3,16,6]
    %cst1 = stablehlo.constant dense<[2, 3, 1, 0]> : tensor<4xi64>
    %1 = stablehlo.transpose(%arg0, %cst1) : (tensor<6x16x3x3xf32>, tensor<4xi64>) -> tensor<3x3x16x6xf32>

    %2 = stablehlo.convolution(
      %0, %1,
      window_strides = [1, 1],
      padding = [0, 0, 0, 0],
      lhs_dilation = [1, 1],
      rhs_dilation = [1, 1],
      feature_group_count = 1,
      batch_group_count = 1,
      dimension_numbers = #stablehlo.convolution<
        input_batch_dimension = 0,
        input_feature_dimension = 3,
        input_spatial_dimensions = [1, 2],
        kernel_input_feature_dimension = 2,
        kernel_output_feature_dimension = 3,
        kernel_spatial_dimensions = [0, 1],
        output_batch_dimension = 0,
        output_feature_dimension = 3,
        output_spatial_dimensions = [1, 2]
      >,
      precision_config = []
    ) : (tensor<16x7x7x16xf32>, tensor<3x3x16x6xf32>) -> tensor<16x5x5x6xf32>

    // Transpose output from NHWC [16,5,5,6] to NCHW [16,6,5,5]
    %cst2 = stablehlo.constant dense<[0, 3, 1, 2]> : tensor<4xi64>
    %3 = stablehlo.transpose(%2, %cst2) : (tensor<16x5x5x6xf32>, tensor<4xi64>) -> tensor<16x6x5x5xf32>
    return %3 : tensor<16x6x5x5xf32>
  }
}

    %cst_scaling = stablehlo.constant dense<2.0> : tensor<f32>

      rhs_dilation = [1, 1],

        input_batch_dimension = 0,
        input_feature_dimension = 1,
        input_spatial_dimensions = [2, 3],

        kernel_output_feature_dimension = 0,
        kernel_spatial_dimensions = [2, 3],
        output_batch_dimension = 0,
        output_feature_dimension = 1,
        output_spatial_dimensions = [2, 3]

      batch_group_count = 1,
      precision_config = []
      : (tensor<6x8x6x6xf32>, tensor<7x8x3x3xf32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>

    %conv_bias_bcast = stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim %conv_bias, dims = [1] : (tensor<7xf32>) -> tensor<1x7x1x1xf32>

      %conv_plus_bias, %cst_zero
      dimensions = [0,2,3]

    %mean_bcast_full = stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim %mean_bcast, dims = [0,1,2,3] : (tensor<1x7x1x1xf32>) -> tensor<6x7x4x4xf32>

}
